title: MacroPulse Alert
message:
PPI Jul 2026: 4.7% y/y vs 4.9% exp (prior 5.5%) — second soft print in two days
Claims wk/Aug 8: 209K vs 202K exp — labour softening continues
Sept Fed hike bets fading further; gold holding above $4,400
SEC votes Aug 14 on "Regulation Crypto" — 4-yr startup runway, first Atkins-era formal rulemaking
